what: The section is pinned to the screen (default +200%), and as you scroll, several lines stacked in one place turn like a wheel. For each line, with r as the number of steps away from center, it moves down 90px (44px on phones) times r, rotates rotateX −25r°, moves back 100|r|px, scales to 1−.15|r|, and fades to opacity 1−.6|r| (0 beyond 1.5 steps). Text color is bright only at center and darker farther away.

options.pin: What to pin — self (this element, default) · parent (the immediate outer section) · false (not pinned, rotates as it passes)
options.gapMobile: Row gap (px) at 767px and below, default 44
options.dim: Text color share for the farthest row (0–1), default 0.4 — original rgb(102) / 255
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One rotating line at a time
options.--fx-wheel-on: Center line color, default text color
options.--fx-wheel-off: Color the far lines blend into, default var(--kf-bg)
